# Version 3.116.0
> **Stable Skia m116 release** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 delivers the stable m116-based release with modern .NET and WebAssembly support. It rolls up the 3.0 previews, including new graphics APIs, view improvements, and the removal of obsolete v2 APIs.

## Breaking Changes

- **Obsolete v2 APIs were removed** — Deprecated graphics, text, bitmap, codec, and OpenGL APIs are no longer available. Replace each call with the successor named in the API diff before upgrading. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539))
- **Legacy Index8 bitmap support was removed** — Color-table and Index8 bitmap and codec overloads are gone. Use supported color types and the current pixel installation and decoding overloads.

## Engine

- **Stable Skia m116 renderer** — Ships the cumulative m116 engine update from the 3.0 preview line. — ❤️ [@Redth](https://github.com/Redth) ([#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#2885](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2885), [#3026](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3026))

## API Surface

- **Span-based geometry APIs** — Adds span overloads for mapping points and vectors and for building polygon paths. — ❤️ [@alexandrvslv](https://github.com/alexandrvslv), [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#3030](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3030), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949), [#2879](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2879))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly and Blazor support improved** — Adds multithread and SIMD WebAssembly support and fixes Blazor applications hosted beneath a base path. ([#2620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2620), [#3089](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3089), [#3087](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3087), [#3081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3081), [#3093](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3093))

## Bug Fixes

- **View and native lifetime fixes** — Fixes MAUI and Uno canvas behavior, Apple Metal snapshots, kerning, and cloned paint disposal. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313), [@jeromelaban](https://github.com/jeromelaban), [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast), [@pdjonov](https://github.com/pdjonov), [@jeremy-visionaid](https://github.com/jeremy-visionaid) ([#2955](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2955), [#2918](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2918), [#2854](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2854), [#2804](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2804), [#2858](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2858), [#2904](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2904))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Bundles the updated HarfBuzzSharp binding used throughout the stable 3.116 release.
